title: Gradient Lichen
description: Making gradients more approachable with custom lichen colors
body:
Ever wanted to make gradients, but then needed stacks of unrelated blocks to fit the right colors? Gradient lichen to the rescue! This mod adds Dull and Faded lichen to decorate builds with darker and lighter colours respectively!

![Gradient from blackstone to calcite featuring new lichen colors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e49bb1ae28bc5503e9d539b4a1ca46f3549758d.png)

Feel free to use this mod in any way you see fit (content creation etc.), though I forbid redistribution (where you pretend it's your mod) and require credit if you publish a modified version with the modifications also clearly listed.
